passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of My creditors did I sell you? Look, you were sold for your iniquities, and for your transgressions your mother was sent away.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD asks a question.
The LORD says, "Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce?
Did I give her a certificate when I sent her away?
To which of My creditors did I sell you?
I did not sell you to any creditor.
You were sold because of your sins.
Your mother was sent away because of your transgressions."
passages.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣י זֶ֠ה סֵ֣פֶר כְּרִית֤וּת אִמְּכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁלַּחְתִּ֔יהָ א֚וֹ מִ֣י מִנּוֹשַׁ֔י אֲשֶׁר־ מָכַ֥רְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם ל֑וֹ הֵ֤ן בַּעֲוֺנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ נִמְכַּרְתֶּ֔ם וּבְפִשְׁעֵיכֶ֖ם שֻׁלְּחָ֥ה אִמְּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Why was no one there when I arrived? Why did no one answer when I called? Is My hand too short to redeem you? Or do I lack the strength to deliver you? Behold, My rebuke dries up the sea; I turn the rivers into a desert; the fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with power and authority.
He says, “Why was no one there when I arrived?
Why did no one answer when I called?
Is My hand too short to redeem you?
Do I lack the strength to deliver you?
I rebuke the sea, and it dries up.
I turn rivers into a desert.
The fish rot because there is no water.
The fish die of thirst.”
passages.original: מַדּ֨וּעַ בָּ֜אתִי וְאֵ֣ין אִ֗ישׁ קָרָֽאתִי֮ וְאֵ֣ין עוֹנֶה֒ הֲקָצ֨וֹר קָצְרָ֤ה יָדִי֙ מִפְּד֔וּת וְאִם־ אֵֽין־ בִּ֥י כֹ֖חַ לְהַצִּ֑יל הֵ֣ן בְּגַעֲרָתִ֞י אַחֲרִ֣יב יָ֗ם אָשִׂ֤ים נְהָרוֹת֙ מִדְבָּ֔ר תִּבְאַ֤שׁ דְּגָתָם֙ מֵאֵ֣ין מַ֔יִם וְתָמֹ֖ת בַּצָּמָֽא׃

passages.text: I clothe the heavens in black and make sackcloth their covering.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD has great power.
The LORD covers the heavens with darkness.
The LORD makes the sky black.
The LORD puts sackcloth over the heavens as a covering.
passages.original: אַלְבִּ֥ישׁ שָׁמַ֖יִם קַדְר֑וּת וְשַׂ֖ק אָשִׂ֥ים כְּסוּתָֽם׃ס

passages.text: The Lord GOD has given Me the tongue of discipleship, to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning; He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD gives Me the tongue of a disciple.
He teaches Me to speak words that help those who are weary.
He wakes Me every morning.
He opens My ear each day.
He teaches Me to listen like a disciple.
passages.original: אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה נָ֤תַן לִי֙ לְשׁ֣וֹן לִמּוּדִ֔ים לָדַ֛עַת לָע֥וּת אֶת־ יָעֵ֖ף דָּבָ֑ר יָעִ֣יר׀ בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֗קֶר יָעִ֥יר לִי֙ אֹ֔זֶן לִשְׁמֹ֖עַ כַּלִּמּוּדִֽים׃

passages.text: The Lord GOD has opened My ears, and I have not been rebellious, nor have I turned back.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD is the subject.
The Lord GOD opened My ears.
I did not rebel.
I did not turn back.
passages.original: אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ פָּתַֽח־ לִ֣י אֹ֔זֶן וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֣א מָרִ֑יתִי אָח֖וֹר לֹ֥א נְסוּגֹֽתִי׃

passages.text: I offered My back to those who struck Me, and My cheeks to those who tore out My beard. I did not hide My face from scorn and spittle.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD gave Me the tongue of a disciple.
He gave Me wisdom to help the weary with words.
He wakes Me every morning.
He opens My ear to listen like a disciple.
I am the servant of the Lord GOD.
I gave My back to those who struck Me.
I gave My cheeks to those who pulled out My beard.
I did not hide My face from shame.
I did not hide My face from spit.
passages.original: גֵּוִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לְמַכִּ֔ים וּלְחָיַ֖י לְמֹֽרְטִ֑ים פָּנַי֙ לֹ֣א הִסְתַּ֔רְתִּי מִכְּלִמּ֖וֹת וָרֹֽק׃

passages.text: Because the Lord GOD helps Me, I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set My face like flint, and I know that I will not be put to shame.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD helps Me.
I have not been disgraced.
I set My face like flint.
I know I will not be put to shame.
passages.original: וַאדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ יַֽעֲזָר־ לִ֔י עַל־ כֵּ֖ן לֹ֣א נִכְלָ֑מְתִּי עַל־ כֵּ֞ן שַׂ֤מְתִּי פָנַי֙ כַּֽחַלָּמִ֔ישׁ וָאֵדַ֖ע כִּי־ לֹ֥א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃

passages.text: The One who vindicates Me is near. Who will dare to contend with Me? Let us confront each other! Who has a case against Me? Let him approach Me!
passages.sermon:
God is the One who vindicates Me.
God is near to Me.
No one can stand against Me.
Who will argue with Me?
Let us stand together.
Who has a case against Me?
Let him come near to Me.
passages.original: קָרוֹב֙ מַצְדִּיקִ֔י מִֽי־ יָרִ֥יב אִתִּ֖י נַ֣עַמְדָה יָּ֑חַד מִֽי־ בַ֥עַל מִשְׁפָּטִ֖י יִגַּ֥שׁ אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: Surely the Lord GOD helps Me. Who is there to condemn Me? See, they will all wear out like a garment; the moths will devour them.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD helps Me.
No one can condemn Me.
All who oppose Me will wear out like a garment.
Moths will devour them.
passages.original: הֵ֣ן אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ יַֽעֲזָר־ לִ֔י מִי־ ה֖וּא יַרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי הֵ֤ן כֻּלָּם֙ כַּבֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֔וּ עָ֖שׁ יֹאכְלֵֽם׃

passages.text: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of His Servant? Who among you walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of the LORD; let him lean on his God.
passages.sermon:
This passage speaks to people who fear the LORD and obey His Servant.
Some people walk in darkness.
They have no light.
Let these people trust in the name of the LORD.
Let them lean on their God.
passages.original: מִ֤י בָכֶם֙ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁמֵ֖עַ בְּק֣וֹל עַבְדּ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ הָלַ֣ךְ חֲשֵׁכִ֗ים וְאֵ֥ין נֹ֙גַהּ֙ ל֔וֹ יִבְטַח֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וְיִשָּׁעֵ֖ן בֵּאלֹהָֽיו׃

passages.text: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who array yourselves with firebrands, walk in the light of your fire and of the firebrands you have lit! This is what you will receive from My hand: You will lie down in a place of torment.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to people who try to make their own light.
You kindle a fire.
You surround yourselves with firebrands.
You walk by the light of your own fire.
You walk by the firebrands you have lit.
God says this is what you will receive from Him.
You will lie down in torment.
passages.original: הֵ֧ן כֻּלְּכֶ֛ם קֹ֥דְחֵי אֵ֖שׁ מְאַזְּרֵ֣י זִיק֑וֹת לְכ֣וּ׀ בְּא֣וּר אֶשְׁכֶ֗ם וּבְזִיקוֹת֙ בִּֽעַרְתֶּ֔ם מִיָּדִי֙ הָיְתָה־ זֹּ֣את לָכֶ֔ם לְמַעֲצֵבָ֖ה תִּשְׁכָּבֽוּן׃פ
